meta.title: agentic_youtube: AI YouTube Playback Test Agent

views.label: AI loop
views.note: Claude picks one typed tool per turn; Python runs it on the bound phone and returns the result.

views.label: Self-healing
views.note: A built-in step fails, the AI reads the screen, taps, verifies, then saves a recipe for that phone profile.

views.label: Scripted path
views.note: play_youtube.py runs free first; only phones that fail are handed to the AI with --ai-fallback.

views.label: Device I/O
views.note: Every phone action goes through ADB or uiautomator2 over USB debugging.

views.label: Outputs
views.note: Reports and logcat land in reports/ and logs/; learned steps land in learned_recipes.json.

components.label: Tester
components.sublabel: runs a CLI on the PC

cards.title: WHO
items: Tester: runs agent.py or play_youtube.py from a terminal
Claude (CLAUDE_MODEL, default claude-opus-5): decides the next step
Android phones over USB: the devices under test

cards.title: WHAT
items: Plays one YouTube URL on 1+ phones for --duration minutes
Turns on Stats for nerds and full screen, then checks that playback stays healthy
Ends with PASS / FAIL / NEEDS_HUMAN, saved as JSON in reports/

cards.title: WHEN
items: play_youtube.py runs first at no token cost; --ai-fallback calls the AI only for phones that fail
agent.py runs the AI agent on every phone straight away
On later runs, saved recipes replay automatically, so a phone profile only has to be worked out once

cards.title: WHERE
items: Python on your PC (ai_test_agent/); Claude API in the cloud
Phone reached through adb and the uiautomator2 jar in /data/local/tmp
State on disk: learned_recipes.json, reports/*.json, logs/*.log; settings in .env / config.py

cards.title: WHY
items: YouTube's UI differs by maker, app version and language, so the English-only built-in locators break
The agent adapts by reading the screen, verifies the result, and saves it as a recipe
AI cost is paid once per YouTube version + language group, not once per phone

cards.title: HOW: safety
items: Claude sees only 22 typed tools with no shell tool; device_id and URL are bound with functools.partial
Limits enforced in Python: MAX_TOOL_CALLS 60, MAX_LLM_TURNS 60, MAX_RETRIES 2
Monitoring refuses to start until Stats for nerds is visible
If a limit is hit, agent.py writes a NEEDS_HUMAN report itself

cards.title: HOW: verification
items: Playback health comes from dumpsys media_session, polled every 5 s
Falls back to on-screen error text and the play/pause control
get_player_state checks fullscreen from player geometry, which works in any language
Note: README still mentions Appium, but the code uses uiautomator2 and needs no Appium server
